title: VentureX
intro: VentureX is an entrepreneurial pitching platform by the Entrepreneurship Cell at BMS Institute of Technology & Management. It brings promising startups, innovative ideas, and potential investors together.

One-on-one pitch refinement and mentoring ahead of the investor demo day.

sections.heading: A platform for promising ventures
paragraphs: VentureX gives aspiring entrepreneurs a place to pitch their ventures, showcase their innovations, and present their business potential to investors.
It is an opportunity to put a bold idea in front of people who can help it take its next step.

sections.heading: One platform. Two stages.
paragraphs: The journey begins online, where teams share a startup pitch and video demonstration. Selected ventures then move on to a live pitching round, presenting their product, business model, and vision to investors.
VentureX is more than a pitch. It is a chance to showcase innovation, attract investment, and move towards building a successful venture.
